text.p: Hospitality Worldwide Services Inc said Monday it has named Douglas Parker, president of Leonard Parker Co, to also serve as its president.
Hospitality's former president, Alan Friedberg, will remain the company's chief executive and chairman, said Chief Financial Officer Howard Anders.
The company said the decision to make Parker president was part of its recently-completed acquisition of Leonard Parker Co, a purchasing company for the hospitality industry.

Hospitality Worldwide acquried the privately-held company for 1,250,000 newly-issued common shares and $5 million par value of newly-issued convertible preferred, convertible into one million common shares.
